stops.name: Legian
stops.subtitle: Legian to Kintamani, Tanah Lot and north Bali
stops.accom: 6 nights · Breakfast · Standard room · 4★ · Four star hotel in Legian, a short walk from the beach

activities.name: Kintamani village and Tukad Cepung
activities.description: A shared day up to the Kintamani crater rim, with a coffee plantation stop and the light shafts inside the Tukad Cepung cave waterfall.

activities.name: Tanah Lot, Uluwatu and the Kecak dance
activities.description: The sea temple at Tanah Lot, then the cliff top temple at Uluwatu for sunset and the Kecak fire dance in the amphitheatre.

activities.name: North Bali sightseeing tour
activities.description: A shared day north through the hills to the lake temple at Beratan, the twin lakes viewpoint and a waterfall in the rainforest.

program.name: Legian
program.description: Six nights in one four star hotel in Legian, with three shared touring days and two free days for the beach, Ubud or the shops.

1: Arrival at Ngurah Rai Airport and private transfer to your hotel
Check in at your Legian hotel for the whole week
Rest of the day free near the beach
Optional: an evening walk along Legian and Kuta beach
2: Breakfast, then a shared tour up to the Kintamani crater
Coffee plantation tasting on the climb
The crater rim view across Mount Batur and its lake
Light shafts inside the Tukad Cepung cave waterfall
3: Breakfast, then a shared tour to the west coast
Tanah Lot, the sea temple on its rock shelf
Uluwatu temple on the cliffs at sunset
Kecak fire dance in the temple amphitheatre afterwards
4: Breakfast, then a shared day north through the hills
Ulun Danu Beratan, the temple standing on the lake
The twin lakes viewpoint above Bedugul
A rainforest waterfall before the road back
5: Optional: Ubud for the Monkey Forest and the art market
Optional: a cooking class or a Balinese massage
Optional: the rice terraces at Tegalalang
6: Breakfast and a second free day
Optional: a surf lesson with an instructor on Kuta beach
Optional: Waterbom park or Beachwalk mall
Optional: grilled seafood on the sand at Jimbaran
7: Breakfast at the hotel and check out
Private transfer to Ngurah Rai Airport for your flight home

expert.name: Putu
expert.quote: One hotel, six nights, three touring days. Unpack once and let the island come to you.
expert.tip: The shared tours are good value and start early, so breakfast opens before pick up. Use the two free days for Ubud and the beach, and we can add a private car on either if you prefer.

summary: Seven days from one four star base in Legian, with shared touring days to the Kintamani crater and Tukad Cepung waterfall, Tanah Lot and Uluwatu with the Kecak dance, and the lakes of north Bali, plus two free days.
included: Included: 6 nights with daily breakfast; private airport transfers; Kintamani village tour with Tukad Cepung waterfall; Tanah Lot and Uluwatu with the Kecak fire dance; north Bali sightseeing tour, all on a shared basis.
not_included: Not included: international flights; Indonesia visa fees; lunches and dinners; travel insurance; personal expenses.
